pathInstructions.linux.step1.en: Open a terminal and navigate to the directory with cd.
pathInstructions.linux.step1.zh-CN: 打开终端，用 cd 进入目标目录。

pathInstructions.linux.step2.en: Run pwd to print the full path.
pathInstructions.linux.step2.zh-CN: 运行 pwd 输出完整路径。

pathInstructions.linux.step3.en: Copy the output and paste it here.
pathInstructions.linux.step3.zh-CN: 复制输出结果并粘贴到这里。

pathInstructions.linux.tip.en: In most file managers, Ctrl+L reveals the full path in the address bar.
pathInstructions.linux.tip.zh-CN: 大多数文件管理器里，按 Ctrl+L 可以直接显示地址栏中的完整路径。

pathInstructions.mac.step1.en: Open Finder and navigate to the folder.
pathInstructions.mac.step1.zh-CN: 打开 Finder，进入目标文件夹。

pathInstructions.mac.step2.en: Right-click the folder, or Control-click it.
pathInstructions.mac.step2.zh-CN: 右键该文件夹，或按住 Control 键点击。

pathInstructions.mac.step3.en: Hold Option (⌥). The Copy action changes to Copy as Pathname.
pathInstructions.mac.step3.zh-CN: 按住 Option（⌥）键，此时“拷贝”会变成“作为路径名称拷贝”。

pathInstructions.mac.step4.en: Click Copy as Pathname, then paste it here.
pathInstructions.mac.step4.zh-CN: 点击“作为路径名称拷贝”，然后粘贴到这里。

pathInstructions.mac.tip.en: You can also open Terminal, type cd, drag the folder into the terminal window, press Enter, and then run pwd to see the full path.
pathInstructions.mac.tip.zh-CN: 你也可以打开终端，输入 cd，把文件夹拖进终端后回车，再运行 pwd 查看完整路径。

pathInstructions.manual.mac.step1.zh-CN: 在 Finder 中找到目标文件夹。

pathInstructions.manual.mac.step2.en: Hold Option and right-click the folder.
pathInstructions.manual.mac.step2.zh-CN: 按住 Option 键并右键该文件夹。

pathInstructions.manual.mac.step3.zh-CN: 点击“将 <文件夹名称> 拷贝为路径名称”。

pathInstructions.manual.pasteStep.en: Paste the result into the path input.
pathInstructions.manual.pasteStep.zh-CN: 把复制结果粘贴到路径输入框中。

pathInstructions.manual.terminal.step3.en: Copy the output and paste it into the path input.
pathInstructions.manual.terminal.step3.zh-CN: 复制输出结果并粘贴到路径输入框中。

pathInstructions.manual.windows.step1.en: Find the folder in File Explorer.
pathInstructions.manual.windows.step1.zh-CN: 在文件资源管理器中找到目标文件夹。

pathInstructions.manual.windows.step2.en: Hold Shift and right-click the folder.
pathInstructions.manual.windows.step2.zh-CN: 按住 Shift 键并右键该文件夹。

pathInstructions.manualDescription.en: Browser security blocks apps from reading full local paths via a file picker. Copy the absolute path and paste it into the input.
pathInstructions.manualDescription.zh-CN: 浏览器安全限制会阻止应用通过文件选择器读取完整本地路径。请复制绝对路径并粘贴到输入框中。

pathInstructions.title.en: How to get a full path

pathInstructions.windows.step1.en: Open File Explorer and navigate to the folder.
pathInstructions.windows.step1.zh-CN: 打开文件资源管理器，进入目标文件夹。

pathInstructions.windows.step2.en: Click the address bar at the top to reveal the full path.
pathInstructions.windows.step2.zh-CN: 点击顶部地址栏，此时会显示完整路径。

pathInstructions.windows.step3.en: Copy the path, then paste it here.
pathInstructions.windows.step3.zh-CN: 复制这个路径，然后粘贴到这里。

pathInstructions.windows.tip.en: You can also hold Shift, right-click the folder, and choose Copy as path.
pathInstructions.windows.tip.zh-CN: 也可以按住 Shift 键右键文件夹，再选择“复制为路径”。
